faq.a: CRM automation is the practice of creating and updating customer records without manual data entry. In Cekat.AI, every interaction, a chat, an order, a campaign received, a website event, automatically creates or updates the customer's CRM card, so your database stays complete and current with no one typing it in.

faq.q: How does Cekat.AI update the CRM automatically?
faq.a: As conversations happen across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and live chat, Cekat.AI captures the details and writes them to the customer's card, new contacts, purchases, campaigns received, and website behavior all land on the profile on their own. Workflow triggers handle labeling, notifications, and syncing between tools.

faq.q: Do I still need to enter customer data by hand?
faq.a: No, that's the entire point. Leads are captured from your website, WhatsApp, and socials automatically, and every later interaction updates the card by itself. Manual entry is exactly what makes most CRMs go stale, so Cekat.AI removes it from your team's day completely.

faq.q: Does automating the CRM reduce errors?
faq.a: Yes. Manual entry produces typos, duplicate contacts, and half-filled fields. When data is captured directly from the conversation, there is nothing to mistype and nothing to forget. Your records stay clean and consistent, so follow-ups, broadcasts, and reports all run on data you can trust.

faq.q: What information gets captured on each card?
faq.a: Each customer profile holds purchases, full chat history, campaigns received, and website behavior and event logs, plus their Customer Stage, Visitor, Lead, or Buyer. The whole relationship sits in one living record instead of scattered across separate apps and spreadsheets.

faq.q: Can I set my own automation rules?
faq.a: Yes. Workflow triggers run on time-based schedules, chat keywords, or customer-data changes such as a new lead, and can fire auto-labeling, tickets, admin notifications, and data sync between tools. You set the rules once with no coding, and they run automatically from then on.

faq.q: How does CRM automation help my sales team?
faq.a: It gives them back their selling hours. Instead of logging contacts and updating spreadsheets, reps work a pipeline that fills and updates itself. They see real-time sales progress and always-current profiles, so their time goes into conversations that close deals rather than into data entry.

Conversations from WhatsApp (official Business API), Instagram DM, Facebook Messenger, website live chat, and API channels all arrive in one unified inbox, and every one of them updates the customer's CRM card automatically, alongside their website behavior and event logs.

faq.q: Is the customer data handled securely?
faq.a: Yes. Cekat.AI complies with UU PDP, Indonesia's personal data protection law, and uses role-based team access so you control who can see and manage customer data. As an official Meta Business Partner, WhatsApp traffic also runs through Meta's official infrastructure.
